traits.inflorescence.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): dense globose heads or loose branched axes of globose partial heads.

traits.life_span.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): woody or herbaceous rhizomatous perennials (some pachycaul).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): leaves usually spiral, sometimes two-ranked.

traits.leaf_division.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): leaves simple, linear to needle-like.

traits.perianth.note: DELTA Dasypogonaceae (read 2026-10-16): six tepals in two whorls, usually petaloid.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Dasypogonaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
